title: SignalGen high threshold
requirements:
REQ-HM-001 The SignalGen component shall provide a command that sets a high threshold.
REQ-HM-002 The SignalGen component shall report the active high threshold via telemetry.
REQ-HM-003 The SignalGen component shall emit a warning event when the signal output exceeds the high threshold.
ticket: Implement REQ-HM-001, REQ-HM-002, and REQ-HM-003 on Ref::SignalGen.

files.patch:
async command SET_HIGH_THRESHOLD(threshold: F32)
telemetry HIGH_THRESHOLD: F32
event HighThresholdExceeded severity warning

void SignalGen :: SET_HIGH_THRESHOLD_cmdHandler(...) { this->m_highThreshold = threshold; this->tlmWrite_HIGH_THRESHOLD(threshold); }
void SignalGen :: checkThreshold(F32 value) { if (value > this->m_highThreshold) { this->log_WARNING_HI_HighThresholdExceeded(); } }
